posts: Render Lab reads the skeleton before it renders anything. Open it with an avatar and it reports the rig it found, here a skeleton with 65 bones, then lays out every pose and framing that rig can take. Each tile in the contact sheet is a real render against the live API, with no account, no SDK, and no key.
Click any tile and it loads into the composer with its pose and framing set, ready to copy as a call. Try it on your own avatar at three.ws/render-lab.
